input.rationale: Section 7 is the only liability provision in the Agreement (searches for cap, aggregate and exceed language return nothing else; Sections 10-11 indemnities and Section 13 disclaimer contain no cap). It provides a mutual exclusion of consequential, incidental, indirect, punitive and special damages, with carve-outs for indemnification and breach of confidentiality, but it contains no aggregate liability cap of any kind. The fallback therefore fails on its central material term: there is no mutual cap and no 12-months-of-fees basis, leaving our direct liability unlimited. We inserted a single Section 7(b) sentence establishing a mutual cap of the fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim, with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct expressly outside the cap. We used "fees paid or payable under this Agreement" rather than "by Customer" because Section 5 operates as a revenue share, so a Customer-paid-fees basis would be illusory. The preferred USD 1,000,000 floor and the additional preferred carve-outs (data protection/security, fraud, IP infringement, payment obligations) are not pursued at this fallback target.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual 12-month fees liability cap in Section 7 with carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 7 excludes indirect damages but sets no aggregate cap, so both Parties' direct liability (including ours) is unlimited. We have added our fallback position: a mutual cap of 12 months' fees, with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct sitting outside the cap.

ops.text: Except with respect to a Party's indemnification obligations, breach of confidentiality obligations, gross negligence or willful misconduct, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid or payable under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.
